metas.name: Aralida Hoovugalu
metas.description: The story follows Vijaykumar (Shivarajkumar), a college boy who falls in love with his classmate, Sudha (Vidyashree). Their romance hits a major roadblock when Vijaykumar discovers that Sudha's family has a long-standing, bitter dispute with his own family.

metas.name: Border Diaries
metas.description: Set in an industrial area on the Karnataka-Tamil Nadu border, the story explores the lives of people working there and focuses on emotional borders, love, morality, and survival.

metas.name: Dia
metas.description: Dia tells the story of a young, introvert girl whose routine life brightens up when she falls for Rohith, one of her fellow college mates. Being an introvert girl and trying to express her love becomes the biggest challenge of her life. This romantic drama will make you lose yourself in the emotional journey of a girl falling in love.

metas.name: Full Meals
metas.description: Full Meals movie touches upon Love, Life, and Passion. In the Film, protagonist is a struggling Wedding Photographer who tries to attain his passion and prove himself. In this process he gets entangled in his personal and love life

metas.name: Just Maath Maathalli
metas.description: Siddharth, a singer, embarks on a journey to Singapore to meet and confess his love for Tanu. He meets Adi, a scriptwriter, on his flight and starts narrating the story of his life.

metas.name: Kalyana Mantapa
metas.description: Though Shankara wants to build a wedding hall after breaking his house, the woman residing there, Sudha, objects to the preposterous plan.

metas.name: Love Seasons
metas.description: Revolves around Trust as a powerful force connects people while love quietly grows around it.

metas.name: Bhuvanam Gaganam
metas.description: Bhuvanam Gaganam is a 2025 Kannada language romantic drama film directed by Gireesh Mulimani.

metas.name: Brindavihari
metas.description: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.

metas.name: Veera Madakari
metas.description: Madakar is an honest police officer who is murdered by a local thug, Babji, and his son Munna. After his death, his daughter is mysteriously left at the door of Sathyaraju, Madakar's lookalike.

metas.name: Romeo Juliet
metas.description: Though two college friends become inseparable, the boy is in pursuit of his dream girl. However, with time, he realises that his close friend is his soulmate.

metas.name: Chiranjeevi Sudhakar
metas.description: When Sandhya, a sane woman, is admitted to a psychiatric hospital by a criminal with maleficent intentions towards her family, Sudhakar assumes another identity to rescue her.

metas.name: The Devil
metas.description: Rajashekar (Chief Minister of Karnataka) is framed, so his secretary recruits Krishna, a kindhearted lookalike, to impersonate the violent heir Dhanush. When the real Dhanush returns, both men clash for political power and Rukmini’s love. Krishna must protect Rukmini from Dhanush while also rising as a leader the people trust.

metas.name: Hudugatada Hudugi
metas.description: A rich woman hires a poor man to pose as her boyfriend in order to evade marriage. However, things get complicated when she falls in love with him.

metas.name: Milana
metas.description: Hero is in love with a girl who is forced to marry a police officer. Hero is later forced by his parents to marry a girl liked by them. Here starts the trouble again, even she wants a divorce from him. Will hero divorce her or they are happy with each other is the later part of the story

metas.name: Tamma Sukhagamana Bayasuva
metas.description: Tamma Sukhagamana Bayasuva is a Kannada romantic comedy drama movie written and directed by Ramenahalli Jagannath,starring Golden Star Ganesh in the lead role.

metas.name: Simple Agi Ondh Love Story
metas.description: Rachana persuades her brother to meet her boyfriend's sister, Ithihasini, hoping that cupid would strike them. However, things take a turn when another girl tricks him into falling in love with her.

metas.name: Software Ganda
metas.description: Manu, a software engineer, faces difficulty working under Priya, his short-tempered NRI boss. Priya is forced to leave India due to visa issues and she decides to marry Manu for her selfish needs.

metas.name: Love Mocktail 2
metas.description: A sequel to Love Mocktail. Revolves around Aadi after the demise of his wife Nidhi. How does he move on from such a loss?

metas.name: Flirt
metas.description: Flirt is a romantic-comedy-thriller centered around a young man (portrayed by Chandan Kumar) whose life intertwines with love, friendship and emotional chaos. The film explores relationships, romance and unexpected twists in an entertaining blend of humour, drama and heart. Performances especially by the lead pair are highlighted as the film’s strongest aspect.

metas.name: Auto Raja
metas.description: Raja, an auto-driver, is in awe of the successful actor Shankar Nag. His life changes when he meets Rani, a village girl, who comes to the city to become an actress

metas.name: Love Mocktail
metas.description: Love Mocktail is a 2020 Indian Kannada-language romantic drama film directed by Krishna in his director debut and jointly produced by Krishna, Milana Nagaraj. The film stars Krishna, Milana Nagaraj in the lead roles. The film was released on 31 January 2020.

metas.name: Hondisi Bareyiri
metas.description: A story of a bunch of college friends who reunite after many years. It focuses on their college life, leading to the responsibilities of adulthood and their struggle to find solace amidst their complex relationships.

metas.name: Kempu Gulabi
metas.description: Kempu Gulabi is a Kannada feature film released in 1990. Directed by Vijay , and produced by Smt B Supraja under the banner Vijay Chithralaya.

metas.name: Love OTP
metas.description: Akshay finds himself in a hilarious mess when he falls in love with two girls at the same time, without either of them knowing. To make things worse, his strict father is completely against love. Now, Akshay must juggle both sides, hide the truth, and somehow escape the chaos hes created.

metas.name: Mugil Pete
metas.description: Two families stand at loggerheads in their ideologies. A family that has failed to understand that love plays an important role in a relationship, and the other believes that love is the elixir of any relationship? What happens when Raja and Apoorva fall in love?

metas.name: Nee Thanda Kanike
metas.description: A young boy, who is never loved by his father, grows up to become a spoilt and alcoholic man. However, he turns his life around when he falls in love with a simple woman.

metas.name: Modada Mareyalli
metas.description: Ramanna wishes his son to become a police inspector someday. However, things take a turn when Ramanna is killed by Kaali, a goon.
